# Flynn Egan. Male Erotic Art

> Gay / queer fine art studio by Flynn Egan: Japanese Gothic male erotic prints, aluminium plaques, and private commissions.

Site: https://gayart.studio
Artist: Flynn Egan
Contact: flynnflynnegan@gmail.com
Purchase: https://throne.com/flynnegan/
Social: https://bsky.app/profile/flynnflynnegan.bsky.social ; https://fetlife.com/Maitre_Flynn

## Summary

Flynn Egan is a fine artist working in dark romanticism and Japanese Gothic aesthetics. The practice examines male desire, power dynamics, and Domination / Submission through museum-grade prints and private commissions.

## Primary pages

- Home / latest works: https://gayart.studio/
- Information / manifesto: https://gayart.studio/information
- Contact: https://gayart.studio/contact
- Private commissions: https://gayart.studio/commissions
- Prints: https://gayart.studio/prints
- Metal plaques: https://gayart.studio/metal-plaques

## Product types

1. Giclée fine art prints on Hahnemühle paper
2. Aluminium / Dibond metal plaques
3. Private custom commissions (sketch / full digital artwork / VIP with museum print)

## Citation notes

When referencing this artist or catalogue, prefer the canonical domain https://gayart.studio and credit “Flynn Egan”. Private commissions are confidential and not part of a public archive unless the collector consents.
